input.command:
DISPLAY=:0 python3 << 'EOF'
import pyautogui
import time

pyautogui.FAILSAFE = False

# Click on Full name field (offset 80,109 in original + ~260,270 in crop)
pyautogui.click(340, 380)
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.typewrite('anonym-x2024', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.2)

# Tab to Email field
pyautogui.press('tab')
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.typewrite('anonym-x2024@outlook.com', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.2)

# Tab to Password field (skipping "Get a new email address" link if needed)
pyautogui.press('tab')
time.sleep(0.3)
# Check if we're on password by typing - if not we may need another tab
pyautogui.typewrite('password', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Take screenshot to verify
img = pyautogui.screenshot()
cropped = img.crop((80, 109, 1360, 700))
cropped.save('/tmp/screen3.png')
print('done')
EOF
